selection: v6f for further provisional study; no manufacturing acceptance

inspection.scope: Independent frozen F0 study comparator; neither part has measured OEM interfaces
inspection.intersection_method: Manifold boolean on independently authored closed STL surfaces; not CAD/OEM fit proof

qualification_limits: Assumed bore loads and support stiffnesses; no bolt contact/preload
Pure moments are unit-load identification cases, not a measured vehicle spectrum
No qualified AM material allowable or S-N/strain-life curve
Bare-carrier modal study excludes engine and body inertia

native.added_material_is: Unoptimised 2 mm BCC arm bracing clipped by assumed ShapeKernel masks
native.field_geometry: Corrected source STEP only; voxel fields are derived and the BCC comparison has no solve

candidate.reason: Added BCC has disconnected components and exceeds the mass ceiling

native_surface_audit.selection: Corrected STEP master retained; added BCC rejected above 1.2 kg

transfer.source_frame: Original solver XYZ in mm; no print transform
transfer.solver_case: 4 kN in -Z plus 850 Nm about Y; assumed rigid bore fixture
transfer.stress_location: Element integration-point maximum at corner centroid, then binned; not a tensor/interpolant
transfer.collision_rule: Preserve maximum magnitude and selected displacement direction

material.process: Metal LPBF, flat build; supplier and parameter set unselected

runtime.solver: CalculiX 2.21, Linux ARM64, one thread per solve

native_toolchain.license: Apache-2.0; upstream sources and licence notices remain in native installation; no upstream code vendored
